"""Y06 R21 causal research decision kernel. No exchange, order, execution or runtime integration."""
from __future__ import annotations
import numpy as np

H=3600000
M=300000
def atr14(h,i):
    if i<15:return None
    a=h[i-14:i,:4];p=h[i-15:i-1,3]
    if not (np.isfinite(a).all() and np.isfinite(p).all()):return None
    v=float(np.maximum(a[:,1]-a[:,2],np.maximum(abs(a[:,1]-p),abs(a[:,2]-p))).mean())
    return v if v>0 else None

def old24(h,btc,binance,i,t,qa):
    """Inputs are aligned H1 arrays indexed by bar open, decision at i. Caller supplies causal QA."""
    if not qa or i<73 or not np.isfinite(h[i-48:i,:5]).all() or not np.isfinite(btc[i-73:i,3]).all() or not np.isfinite(btc[i-48:i,:5]).all():return False
    if np.count_nonzero(h[i-48:i,4]>0)<36:return False
    a=atr14(h,i)
    if a is None:return False
    c=h[i-1,3]
    for n in (24,12,6):
        j=i-(t//H)%n
        if j-n-1<0 or not np.isfinite(h[[j-1,j-n-1],3]).all() or not h[j-1,3]<h[j-n-1,3]:return False
    if c/h[i-7,3]-btc[i-1,3]/btc[i-7,3]>=0:return False
    if not c<float(np.min(h[i-13:i-1,2]))-.10*a:return False
    b24=btc[i-1,3]-btc[i-25,3];b72=btc[i-1,3]-btc[i-73,3]
    if (b24>0 and b72>0) or (h[i-4,3]-c)/a>2:return False
    if b24<0 and b72<0:
        if i<169 or not np.isfinite(h[i-169:i-1,2]).all():return False
        if (c-float(h[i-169:i-1,2].min()))/a<.5:return False
        w=btc[i-169:i,3]
        week_up=len(w)==169 and np.isfinite(w).all() and w[0]>0 and w[-1]>w[0]
        f=binance[i-3:i]
        sell=len(f)==3 and np.isfinite(f).all() and f[:,4].sum()>0 and 2*f[:,5].sum()/f[:,4].sum()-1<0
        return bool(week_up or sell)
    return True

def flow(h,v,b,i):
    if i<25 or not np.isfinite(h[i-25:i,3]).all() or not np.isfinite(v[i-24:i]).all() or not np.isfinite(b[i-24:i]).all():return None
    vv=v[i-24:i];bb=b[i-24:i]
    if vv[-3:].sum()<=0 or vv[:-3].sum()<=0:return None
    return float(2*bb[-3:].sum()/vv[-3:].sum()-1),float(vv[-3:].mean()/vv[:-3].mean()),float(h[i-1,3]/h[i-4,3]-1)

def new48_origin(h,aster,binance,i,qa):
    if not qa or i<73 or not np.isfinite(h[i-73:i,:5]).all():return None
    a=flow(h,aster[:,0],aster[:,1],i);b=flow(binance,binance[:,4],binance[:,5],i)
    if a is None or b is None or not np.allclose(aster[i-24:i,0],h[i-24:i,4],rtol=1e-6,atol=1e-6):return None
    if a[0]>=.15 and a[1]>=1.5 and a[2]<0:return a[0]*min(a[1],10)
    return None

def new48_confirm(m,origin,confirmed,qa):
    """Called on completed H1 boundaries after origin, 12/24/36 M5 bars. No future entry price used."""
    if confirmed-origin not in (12,24,36) or origin<0 or confirmed<576 or confirmed>=len(m):return False
    if not qa or not np.isfinite(m[origin,0]) or not np.isfinite(m[confirmed-576:confirmed,:4]).all():return False
    if np.mean(m[confirmed-576:confirmed,4]>0)<.75:return False
    return bool(m[confirmed-1,3]<m[origin,0] and m[confirmed-1,3]<m[confirmed-12,0])
